job.description: N15's full-length calibration run, before any real N15 run: seed 3001 only. Trains rw-b2, rw-b4 and rw-oracle at full length and re-measures N13's n80-rw, N12's sub20 and clean, and N14's sub10, sub05 and sub025 of seed 3001 (read from the n13_calib, n12_calib and n14_calib Drive folders) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024. It decides nothing: it checks that the sharpened heads train and remove random share, which fixes the beta of N15a's arm by the preregistered rule. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 15 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
